'''Ironholgs''' was nickname given to an upgraded version of a [[Holgorian IM-220]] [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] associated with [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]]. Ironholgs was responsible for basic onboard maintenance and security of [[Lanoree Brock's Peacemaker|Brock's ship]]; though it did not have arms. In addition to its basic protocols, Ironholgs was capable of remotely piloting the [[Peacemaker-class cruiser|''Peacemaker''-class cruiser]] during missions. Brock also used it to record her [[Lanoree Brock's Je'daii Journal|journal]]. After their adventures on [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]], a damaged Ironholgs was in need of repair and Brock left him at [[Anil Kesh]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] by a [[Je'daii Journeyer]] who specialized in [[Technician|mechanics]].
